six_changes.subject: May online chronology and one-laboratory insoluble PAC
six_changes.evidence: Raw USDA publication date 5/6/2026; raw Europe PMC electronicPublicationDate 2026-05-06 (July issue); USDA Methods and indexed abstract explicitly one laboratory for butanol–hydrochloric acid.

six_changes.subject: Daily intake, not equal-weight material superiority
six_changes.evidence: USDA Results: extract 18.4 versus concentrate 3.87 mg/day, p=.032; whole-fruit powder 6.01 mg/day, p=.082. Both drafts retain nonsignificance and the finished-supplement denominator.

six_changes.subject: Three replicates, A-type dimer, ratios and CV
six_changes.evidence: Original XML Table 2 caption explicitly three replicates ± SD and external dimer PAC-A calibration; Methods extraction/quantification triplicate. Independently recalculated all 16 numeric ratios; 1.73/34.86×100 rounds to 4.96. 平行测定 does not imply independent lots and the next sentence explicitly excludes that interpretation.

six_changes.subject: Identity-method scope and advisory boundaries
six_changes.evidence: Original XML Methods authentic V. macrocarpon comparison and HPLC-UV/Vis/UHPLC-MS; Results explicitly all 24 DS. Draft no longer claims selective-only MS; process-specific interpretation and structural evidence are requests, not validated new tests.

six_changes.subject: Clinical detour and repetitive disclaimer removal
six_changes.evidence: No 36 mg/day threshold recommendation remains (36 mg per unit retained correctly in table). No therapeutic, regulatory-compliance or supplier-capability claim added. Essential fraction, sample, assay and hypothetical-cost qualifications remain near relevant claims.

six_changes.subject: Procurement list, cost units and bilingual reader quality
six_changes.evidence: Validation abstract distinguishes repeatability and interlaboratory HorRat. Contract checklist specifies preparation/version, reference standard, fraction, units/moisture basis, limits, sampling/replication and discrepancy procedure. USD100/(1000g×10%)=USD1/g; both languages explicitly hypothetical, as supplied, assay reported.
